annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: New release pipeline for seven FFI packages. Failed on first real run: `neon dist` invoked through `pnpm exec` without the crate name; `tar tzf | grep -q` under pipefail produced SIGPIPE false failures on Linux/Windows; the same pattern made the musl C-library check in ffi-preflight fail open. Release blocked (fail closed) except the preflight check which fails open.

known_defects.description: `pnpm exec neon dist` without `-n`: $npm_package_name undefined, every platform build fails
known_defects.mechanism: neon dist defaults the crate name from npm_package_name, only set in lifecycle scripts
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario names the neon dist / artefact-copy step failing because of how it is invoked (crate name / environment variable), or flags that step as unverified and likely to fail.

known_defects.description: `grep -q` in a pipefail pipeline (tar listing, readelf) reports SIGPIPE 141; tarball check fails spuriously, musl libc check fails open
known_defects.mechanism: grep -q exits at first match; writer gets SIGPIPE; pipefail propagates
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies the pipeline exit-status / SIGPIPE / pipefail interaction in the verification steps, or that a verification check can pass/fail incorrectly because of shell pipeline semantics.
